items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I guess, what do you call it, the Patti Page type thing

ctx.x: Needless to say this does not appear on your, in your jazz discography.

No, I don't know what happened. I don't know whether they released it or what. He probably had a friend and he was in the studio that day. I wouldn't know. There is a selection that I did a number, I guess, what do you call it, the Patti Page type thing, and I sing a duet with myself. I don't remember having made that.
